Now let me look at how the tm_writer is used and how the format string is parsed. Let me look at the `format` function for chrono timepoints and the `do_write` function.

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fmt && sed -n '410,450p' include/fmt/chrono.h && echo "---" && grep -n "tm_writer\|on_iso_date\|on_us_date\|on_iso_time\|on_12_hour_time" include/fmt/chrono.h | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜ode>

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fmt && sed -n '1370,1500p' include/fmt/chrono.h</parameter>
